activity_screen.rule_ar: تُستبعد الشركات النشطة في: تداول الذهب والفضة نقدًا على أساس مؤجل؛ الإعلان عن الخنزير أو الخمور أو القمار أو التبغ أو الخدمات المالية التقليدية أو غيرها من الأنشطة غير الإسلامية (ووسائل الإعلان المخالفة للإسلام)؛ الموسيقى والمواد الإباحية وترفيه البالغين (باستثناء القنوات الإخبارية والصحف والقنوات الرياضية وقنوات الأطفال والقنوات التعليمية)؛ الخمور (تصنيعًا وتقطيرًا وتعبئة وبيعًا بالجملة ونقلًا وبيعًا)؛ الخدمات المالية التقليدية — باستثناء البنوك الإسلامية والمؤسسات المالية الإسلامية وشركات التأمين الإسلامية كما تعرّفها المنهجية؛ القمار؛ الأنشطة المرتبطة بالخنزير؛ التبغ والسجائر الإلكترونية ومنتجات التبخير؛ والقنب الترفيهي (باستثناء المنتجات المنتجة والمباعة والمستهلكة تحت إشراف طبي). الشركة التي يقل دخلها التشغيلي غير المباح — شاملًا كل دخل الفوائد — عن 5% من إجمالي دخل الأعمال تجتاز فحوص القطاعات رغم ذلك (منهجية مؤشرات S&P الشرعية، نوفمبر 2026).
activity_screen.rule_en: Companies active in the following are excluded: trading of gold and silver as cash on a deferred basis; advertising of pork, alcohol, gambling, tobacco, conventional financial services or other non-Islamic activities (and advertising means/modes contravening Islam); music, pornography and adult entertainment -- producers, promoters, broadcasters, marketers, publishers, games with adult themes, music content, cinemas, conventional movies/shows (exceptions: news channels, newspapers, sports channels, children's channels, educational channels); alcohol (brewers, distillers, packagers, wholesalers, transporters, sellers); conventional financial services -- EXCEPT Islamic banks, Islamic financial institutions and Islamic insurance companies as the methodology defines them (a Shariah Supervisory Board or scholar supervising all activities, all products Islamic, all investments and non-operating activities Islamic, and passing the accounting-based screens); gambling; pork-related activities; tobacco and electronic cigarettes/vaping products, including tobacco alternative products meant for consumption as tobacco; and recreational cannabis (exception: products produced, sold and consumed under medical supervision for health reasons). A company whose operating business non-permissible income -- including ALL interest income -- is below 5% of total business income still passes the sector-based screens (S&P Shariah Indices Methodology, November 2026).

basis: S&P Shariah Indices Methodology, November 2026 (S&P Dow Jones Indices): sector-based screens; accounting-based screens as revised effective 2026-09-18 (leverage and cash each below 30% of the 36-month average market value of equity); dividend purification. Screening is performed for S&P DJI by Ratings Intelligence Partners (RI) under a Shariah Supervisory Board; the screens run monthly and use the latest financial statement (annual preferred when available). Encoded from S&P DJI's own current methodology document -- supplied by Muhammad on 2026-11-18 after spglobal.com proved unreachable from the build environment -- as issue #169's pin gate requires.
name_en: S&P Shariah Indices Methodology (November 2026) — S&P Dow Jones Indices
notes: Exactly TWO accounting-based ratios exist in the current methodology. The pre-2023 accounts-receivable screen (below 49% of the same 36-month base) was abolished and is deliberately NOT encoded; between September 2023 and September 2026 only the leverage ratio applied, and the cash ratio was restored on 2026-09-18 with both limits tightened from 33% to 30%.

Buffer / hysteresis: a stock compliant at the prior evaluation that exceeds a maximum remains compliant while the ratio is within 2 percentage points of the maximum; breaching for 3 consecutive evaluation periods makes it non-compliant, and above the buffer limit it is non-compliant immediately (mirror rule for a non-compliant stock becoming compliant). That is index-membership mechanics over successive evaluations; this engine evaluates one statement period point-in-time, so the buffer is recorded per ratio under 'buffers' as methodology metadata and is NOT applied to the verdict -- a documented divergence from index practice, not an encoded threshold.

The methodology exempts companies run on a fully Shariah-compliant basis (Shariah Supervisory Board; all business and financial transactions Shariah-compliant; incorporated and managed in a fully Shariah-compliant manner) from the accounting-based screens. That exemption is not encoded: the activity classification is an input to this engine, and such a company's snapshot is screened on the same declared ratios.

The cash numerator is the methodology's 'Cash & Deposits + Interest Bearing Securities'. In this data model, term deposits and treasury bills sit inside interest_bearing_assets and current accounts, cheques and cash sit inside cash_and_liquid_assets, so the numerator is the sum of the two fields -- the same composite numerator the MSCI pack encodes. The leverage numerator is the methodology's 'Debt' (unspecified); the data model's interest_bearing_debt is the input pipeline's corresponding figure.

Total business income in the methodology = total operating income + all forms of interest income (operating and non-operating); the data model's total_revenue is the input pipeline's corresponding figure, and all interest income sits inside non_compliant_revenue.

capital_component.definition_ar: تعرّف منهجية S&P الشرعية تطهير التوزيعات فقط (نسبة التطهير = التوزيعات × (الإيرادات غير المباحة / إجمالي الدخل))؛ لا تنشر تطهيرًا للأرباح الرأسمالية، فلا يُعلن مكوّن رأسمالي.
capital_component.definition_en: The S&P Shariah methodology defines dividend purification only (Purification ratio = Dividends x (Non-Permissible Revenue / Total Income)); no capital-gains purification is published, so no capital component is declared.

purification.notes_ar: تطهّر S&P DJI التوزيعات بنسبة الدخل غير المباح: نسبة التطهير = التوزيعات × (الإيرادات غير المباحة / إجمالي الدخل)، حيث الإيرادات غير المباحة = إيرادات الأنشطة غير المباحة + كل دخل الفوائد (التشغيلي وغير التشغيلي) + دخل الاستثمارات المالية غير التشغيلية + الدخل غير التشغيلي، وإجمالي الدخل = إجمالي الدخل التشغيلي + كل دخل الفوائد + الدخل غير التشغيلي. فحصة التوزيع الواجبة التطهير هي نسبة الدخل غير المتوافق — وهي نسبة التطهير في هذا المعيار. لا تنشر المنهجية قيمة تطهير للسهم الواحد.
purification.notes_en: S&P DJI purifies dividends by the non-permissible share of income: Purification ratio = Dividends x (Non-Permissible Revenue / Total Income), where non-permissible revenue = revenue/income from non-permissible activities + all interest income (operating and non-operating) + income from non-operating financial investments + non-operating income, and total income = total operating income + all interest income + non-operating income. The share of a dividend to purify is therefore the non-permissible income ratio -- this rule set's purification ratio. The methodology publishes no per-share purification figure, so per_share_definition is null and no per-share figure is produced.

ratios.label_en: Non-permissible income (incl. ALL interest income) / total business income
